# Shahan Ali (ProBoy, itx_proboy, shahan315, proboy315)

> Shahan Ali, also known as ProBoy, itx_proboy, shahan315 and proboy315, is a full-stack developer, bot architect and Shopify expert from Burewala, Punjab, Pakistan. He builds web applications, the ProBoy-MD WhatsApp bot, custom Shopify e-commerce, and AI integrations while studying ICS 1st Year at Govt Graduate College Burewala.

- Site: https://proboy.vercel.app
- Email: shahanali.dev@gmail.com
- WhatsApp: +92 326 1684315

## Projects
- [ProBoy-MD](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/proboy-md): An advanced WhatsApp automation bot developed by Shahan Ali.
- [ProBoy-SiM_Database](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/proboy-sim-database): An interactive lookup tool for simulation database files and cellular activation reports.
- [ProBoy CamLink](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/proboy-camlink): A camera shortlink system with device diagnostics and captured image viewing.
- [ProBoy JS Obfuscator](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/proboy-js-obfuscator): A client-side JavaScript obfuscation tool for protecting production source code.
- [ProBoy Encrypt & Decrypt](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/proboy-encrypt-decrypt): An AES-256-GCM encryption suite with image steganography and a local history vault.

## Showcase demos
- [LuxeCart](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/luxecart): Premier luxury watch marketplace featuring Swiss tourbillons, multi-category catalogs, instant shopping cart, 1-click checkout, and live merchant admin portal.

- [Artivio](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/artivio): Digital fine art gallery with live auction bidding counters, verified 1/1 artwork lots, collector suites, and curator admin console.
